description: Screens a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against the OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, the UN Security Council consolidated list and the UK Sanctions List (about 27,000 entries with aliases). Fuzzy matching ignores word order, accents, punctuation and legal forms. Each match: 0-100 score, list, listed name, type, programs, aliases, birth date, nationality. Not legal advice. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

lists.description: Only these lists, comma-separated: ofac, un, uk (default all)
